bullets.text: Chennai experienced extremely heavy overnight monsoon rainfall reaching up to 36 cm, causing widespread flooding because mouths of rivers and drains were not properly desilted.
Velachery was severely impacted by overnight downpours submerging cars and two-wheelers, prompting the deployment of the National Disaster Response Force with boats and life-saving equipment.
Heavy rains flooded streets and homes across Chennai while stagnant water persisted in Velachery and Perambur even after floodwaters drained elsewhere by morning.
An elderly retired officer named Rajagopalan came to complain to Minister R. Kumar in Velachery during heavy rains and narrowly escaped TVK cadres.
Residents of AGS Colony in Velachery confronted Minister R. Kumar about flooding during every rain despite knowing the area is built on a lake bed, demanding real solutions instead of excuses.
Municipal corporation workers took swift action to pump out accumulated rainwater and clear roads in Velachery, helping traffic and normalcy return.
Residents near the swimming pool area in Velachery AGS Colony continued facing severe issues with stagnant rainwater despite the installation of stormwater drains.
Velachery residents shared mixed views on local news debates regarding whether stormwater drainage systems successfully mitigated heavy flooding during the intense rains.
A giant tree fell on an electricity pole in Shanmuha Nagar in Thirumazhisai, causing an eight-hour power outage before Tamil Nadu Generation and Distribution Corporation workers restored supply.
Seeman strongly opposed the construction of a clinker grinding plant in Tiruttani due to the severe danger of environmental damage in the Thiruvallur district.
The Ministry of Electronics and IT STPI Tech Conclave highlighted artificial intelligence applications in healthcare and assistive technologies alongside startups and medical experts.
The MeitY Secretary stated that artificial intelligence can make healthcare more accessible and affordable by improving disease screening, diagnostics, and remote patient monitoring.
The central government asked Meta to ensure that recommendation systems on Facebook and Instagram do not disproportionately expose users to a single or limited set of narratives.
Following intense overnight rain in Chennai, the Chief Minister ordered all in-charge ministers to immediately rush to Chennai to oversee precautionary and relief operations.
Media reports and opposition platforms questioned the absence of designated in-charge ministers in Chennai during the peak of the overnight heavy rainfall crisis.
